segments.en:
And therefore: "prey He gave to those who fear Him." And since this [money] is from the aspect of the gevuros — it sometimes turns to anger — and this becomes "one who tears his soul in his anger" [toref nafsho b'apo] — for anger is also from the aspect of the gevuros — as elaborated above in the discourse.

"The essential completeness of the Tzaddik." And so on. How this discourse was said — was elaborated above in what we elaborated in the discourse Ki Merachamam Yenahalem, Siman 7.

segments.he: עיקר שלימות הצדיק וכו' מאמר זה איך שנאמר נתבאר למעלה במה שביארנו במאמר כי מרחמם ינהגם סימן ז':
